common_demands: Customers consistently state budget ranges and ask for per-square-foot or total price breakdowns.
Home loan, EMI, down payment, and bank loan options are repeatedly requested.
Site visit scheduling during weekends, evenings, and specific days is a frequent requirement.
Proximity to schools, colleges, temples, bus stops, and main areas is commonly specified.
Buyers seek clarity on whether a property is readymade, under construction, or custom-built per their design.
Own-use versus investment intent is explicitly stated in most calls.

best_agent.name: Saleem
best_agent.reason: Saleem recorded a single call with the highest interest score of 5 and a scheduled site visit, with only minor remaining clarifications about rate concessions rather than deal blockers.

worst_agent.name: Bhanu Priya
worst_agent.reason: Bhanu Priya handled the largest number of calls but repeatedly struggled with budget mismatches, identity confusion, location ambiguity, site-detail errors, and unconfirmed callbacks, resulting in few scheduled visits and multiple callbacks requested.
